title: Data mid systemdesign metrics reporting pipeline
topic: Data mid systemdesign metrics reporting pipeline
question: How would you design a pipeline that produces this metrics dashboard reliably, and how would you make sure everyone in the company trusts the numbers?
idealAnswer:
Establish a single source of truth for each metric's definition, e.g. exactly what counts as 'active user', agreed on across teams, since disagreement often stems from different definitions rather than different data

Build the pipeline to compute metrics centrally from raw source data into a shared metrics table, so every team's dashboard reads from the same computed values instead of recomputing independently

Include data quality checks and reconciliation, e.g. comparing today's computed revenue against the finance system's numbers, to catch discrepancies before they reach the dashboard

Version or document metric definitions somewhere accessible, e.g. a metrics catalog, so when a definition changes, it's a visible, tracked decision rather than a silent shift that breaks trust

Plan for historical consistency, if a metric definition changes, decide whether to restate history under the new definition or keep it versioned, since silently changing history erodes trust

Mentions access and freshness expectations, e.g. how often the dashboard refreshes and by when it's expected to be ready each day, set clearly so users know what they're looking at
